{{Quote|Stay close, Shadow Three, I'll have those droids cleared out in no time.''"<br />"''You got a chance, Shadow Five, as long as I'm covering you!|Shadow Five and Shadow Three, during the battle over Kadavo|<ref name="Slaves 6" />}}
"'''Shadow Five'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|battle]] was fought over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], after the Republic tried to liberate [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] held inside the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on the planet by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]. Shadow Five participated in the battle and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when their [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] fell under fire from the Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]].

==Biography==
[[File:Shadow_Squadron_Kadavo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Squadron fights during the battle over Kadavo.]]
"Shadow Five" was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]],<ref name="Slaves 6" /> one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shadow Five was a member of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].<ref name="Slaves 6" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Kadavo date" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] planned to liberate [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who were being held in a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Kenobi, CT-7567, and the Togruta had been enslaved by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] slavers, who were allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's enemy in the war. A Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was sent to Kadavo; Shadow [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] were among the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] dispatched there. Having arrived at Kadavo, Skywalker, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led a [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|surface attack]], trying to break into the Labor Processing Hub, while the Republic fleet remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the planet.<ref name="Slaves 6" />

A Confederate fleet soon arrived at Kadavo as well, in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] both the slaves and the Zygerrians. As a battle ensued between the Republic and the Confederate fleets, Shadow Squadron, flying [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], engaged enemy [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. Shadow Five and two other Shadow Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] initiated an attack run on a group of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], and Shadow Five asked [[Shadow Three (Kadavo)|Shadow Three]] to stay close. The clones destroyed the initial fighters, but then they were attacked by the Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and her squadron of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]. Shadow Five and the other two clone pilots fell to enemy fire and were all killed. In the end, however, the Republic repelled the Confederate attack and won the battle, liberating the slaves.<ref name="Slaves 6" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all of Jango Fett's clones, Shadow Five stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Five appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars 6]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Slaves 6" /> on [[May 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=comics/15-684/star-wars-the-clone-wars-6-of-6|text=STAR WARS: THE CLONE WARS #6 (OF 6)}}</ref> In [[2011]], when the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'' story arc]] was adapted into three episodes of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], Shadow Five was not included in the adaptation.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>
